v1.metrics_units: USD per insured acre (principal crops: corn+soybeans+wheat+sorghum, nominal USD); r2/spearman unitless; total_bias_pct in percent
v1.unit_of_analysis: county x year, principal crops, counties with >= 2,000 insured acres
v1.interval_note: lo/hi are 5th/95th percentiles over 100 block-bootstrap refits (training years resampled with replacement): parameter/sampling uncertainty of the fitted loss function, not a full predictive interval; county-level 90% coverage is reported to show the gap.

cv.selection_rule: lowest pooled LOYO county-level RMSE of principal-crop $/insured acre, 2001-2020 only

ablations.note: MODIS rows exist 2001-2025; rows with missing MODIS are left to LightGBM's missing-value handling.

labels.v1: pre-registered headline (features fixed before any test year was seen)
labels.v2: post-hoc (feature idea came after seeing the 2022-23 shortfall)

v2.name: v2_ms_only
v2.label: post-hoc (feature idea came after seeing the 2022-23 shortfall)

calibration.county: split-conformal, Mondrian by 10 bins of predicted principal $/insured acre, from LOYO out-of-fold residuals in the training years; nominal 90%
calibration.region_total: 5th/95th pct of log(actual/pred) of LOYO out-of-fold region-year totals
calibration.note: With 20 (11) training years the 5th/95th percentiles of the year-total ratio are close to the most extreme observed ratios.

decision.rule: use v2 only if LOYO CV RMSE (2001-2020) AND 2012-holdout county RMSE are both lower than v1's

cv_v2.label: post-hoc (feature idea came after seeing the 2022-23 shortfall)

note: v1 = pre-registered headline (unchanged). v2 = post-hoc (feature idea came after seeing the 2022-23 shortfall).
